text.en: The placenta is just maternal tissue (part of the mother's uterine lining) that the fetus attaches to, not a distinct organ -- in reality the placenta is a genuinely new organ formed from both fetal (trophoblast-derived) and maternal (endometrial) tissue working together, not simply borrowed maternal tissue.
text.et: Platsenta on lihtsalt ema kude (osa ema emaka limaskestast), mille külge loode kinnitub, mitte eraldiseisev elund -- tegelikult on platsenta tõeliselt uus elund, mis on moodustunud nii loote (trofoblastist pärineva) kui ka ema (endomeetriumi) koe koostööst, mitte lihtsalt laenatud ema kude.
